claims.atomic_claim: Nightfall release checksum-like files can be downloaded.
claims.limitation: Checksum files are not independently trusted.

claims.atomic_claim: Nightfall release binary-like assets were downloaded for SHA256 verification.
claims.limitation: Download does not imply execution or safety.

claims.atomic_claim: Downloaded binary-like assets match published SHA256 checksum entries.
claims.limitation: Matching published checksums do not prove source-to-binary correspondence.
WVP v0.4 intentionally does not execute release binaries.
Safety requires separate security review and cannot be inferred from checksums.
